about: GH-996 card 45 C1: the cue-ball clipping census bars. Every MEASURED web/tools/e2e-lighting-matrix.mjs row (factory and neutral legs, nightly 240 cells and the per-PR slice) must keep cams.player.ballClip <= its bar. Judged by web/tools/lib/lighting-judge.mjs whyCensus; this file is checked by web/tools/test-lighting-matrix-judge.mjs (whyBadBars, the signed values, the measured margin).
definition: the share of cue-ball disc pixels within 0.9 R with any display channel >= 250, matrix player camera, 1280x800 at DSF 1 (web/tools/lib/lighting-matrix.mjs MEASURE_SRC); the row carries the disc pixel count cams.player.ballClipN, which must equal disc_px[table]
rule: bar = ceil((k + 1) / n x 100) / 100 per class over b <= 1 and at b 1.4, where k / n = the LARGEST clipped SHARE measured over the class's cells (k = that cell's clipped-pixel count, n = disc_px of that cell's table; card 45 r4); the values below are the owner-signed bars
